markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (41%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
Benign and InSitu tie at 41%, and Invasive (11%) remains inside the 90% prediction set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 41%, InSitu 41%, Invasive 11%, Normal 8% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Tied between Benign and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude in situ or invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability (70% error AUROC); 98th OOD percentile [F6] | Quality passed, but embedding atypical |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Backbones agree despite probability tie |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (4 InSitu, 1 Invasive) [F5] | Neighbors contradict Benign suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Strongest upward push (+0.49) [F2], 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pulls risk down (-0.32) [F3], 18/20 spot check, caption failed · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 1) · ↑ invasive · Pushes risk up (+0.27) [F4], 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low score lowers risk (-0.27), 19/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 6) · ↓ invasive · Lowers invasive risk (-0.22), 12/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability vs random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.001, CI -0.009 to 0.006); relies on unreliable AI-spot-checked mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 0 and 1 (95%, 99% risk) harbor true in situ or invasive carcinoma at margins [F7].
- The lesion matches its 5 nearest neighbors (4 InSitu, 1 Invasive; 83–85% similarity) rather than benign tissue.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1**: Highest risk (95%, 99%) at superior/medial margins (108 um); verify morphology, ignoring unreliable mitoses and necrosis.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 6**: Check duct confinement (2, 6) and stromal invasion (3; 37% risk) for InSitu vs Invasive.
3. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Confirm benign tubules; review drafted deeper levels order for atypia (frozen-section stains blocked).
